description:
PDF editor for Windows. No account, no subscription, no telemetry.

KillerPDF is a lightweight PDF viewer and toolkit for Windows. View, merge, split, and manage PDF files. Runs portable or installs to your user profile without admin rights. No account, no subscription, no telemetry. Open source under GPLv3.
1.8.61 restores installation and automatic updates.

### Fixed

- Restored installable packages after application metadata drifted from compiled resources.
